templates.text: Sudden shadow passing overhead → eyes widen, arms jerk in a brief startle.
High-contrast edge moves into view → head turns slowly, gaze locks for {seconds} seconds.
Bright light flicker → blinks rapidly, hands clench into loose fists.
Large, looming object approaches → body stills, breathing pauses momentarily.
Red object sways side-to-side → eyes track haltingly, mouth forms a small 'o'.
Sharp change in ambient light level → squints, emits a soft, short vocalization.
Slowly rotating mobile → sustained visual fixation, subtle pedaling of legs.
Fast, jerky motion at periphery → sharp head turn toward stimulus, then away.
Checkerboard pattern presented → alert stillness, increased blink rate.
Face-like shape comes near → eyes brighten, cooing sound follows initial stare.
Light reflection dances on ceiling → quiet alertness, one arm extends toward it.
Object recedes from view → gaze lingers, then drifts, fingers uncurl.
Sudden occlusion of a favored visual target → brief fussy cry, searching head movements.
Steady, moderate-intensity light source → pupils constrict, body relaxes into a calm state.
Complex geometric pattern → intense scanning with eyes, minimal limb movement.
Shadow grows larger rapidly → Moro reflex partially engages, followed by a whimper.
Repetitive horizontal movement → smooth pursuit eye movements initiate, then break.
Color transition from red to blue → blinks, shows a slight orienting head tilt.
Light source suddenly extinguishes → startle, then a low-pitched, grumbling cry.
Slow vertical oscillation → eyes track upward, sucking motions begin without object.
Visual 'ping' of a small, bright target → saccadic jump, hand moves toward midline.
Gradual brightening of the field → eyes open wider, arms stretch out slightly.
Two competing visual stimuli → gaze alternates between them, brief state of arousal.
Predictable, rhythmic visual pulse → entrained limb jerks in time, then habituation.
Unexpected visual texture change → scanning pauses, a single sharp exhale follows.
Sustained eye contact from caregiver → mutual gaze held, stilling of all other movement.
Fade to grey after colorful display → gaze becomes unfocused, a sigh is released.
Strobing at {rate} Hz → grimace, turning away of the head to avoid stimulus.
Edge of a crib bar coming into sharp focus → reaches out clumsily, makes contact.
Simultaneous light and moderate sound → visual stimulus dominates, dampens acoustic startle.
